brief:
Thousands of Israeli settlers entered the Al-Buraq Wall plaza, located west of the Al-Aqsa Mosque in occupied Jerusalem, and performed Talmudic rituals, according to Quds News Network. The Al-Buraq Wall, also known as the Western Wall, is a site of significant religious importance to both Muslims and Jews.

The incident marks another flashpoint at the contested religious site, which has been the focus of recurring tensions between Palestinian and Israeli communities.

title: Israeli settlers storm Al-Buraq Wall plaza in occupied Jerusalem
